l1_words.meaning: occasional, happening from time to time

pattern_explanation: Each of these words came into both languages from the same Latin roots, so the spellings stayed close. Over time the Portuguese forms kept older or narrower senses, while the English forms shifted, so the shared shape no longer guarantees the same meaning.
false_friend_warning: Beware of false friends: the Portuguese verb written as pretender (transliteration: pretender) means to intend, not to pretend, and assistir means to watch, not to assist. Learners who match these words by their look will choose the wrong English verb, so check the meaning before translating.
